newsitem.title: INDIA: Motorola to set up 35 Indian paging outlets.
newsitem.headline: Motorola to set up 35 Indian paging outlets.

text.p: Motorola Inc will set up 35 retail showrooms to market its pagers in India by 1997, the United News of India (UNI) said on Tuesday.

"As part of our distribution strategy for India, we are tying up with several dealers active in the country and setting up these outlets," UNI quoted Fernando Gomez, vice-president and general manager of Motorola (Asia-Pacific paging subscriber division) as saying.
